description: Implement the TelephonyService (thin Twilio adapter), the central webhook controller with tenant routing, the admin CRM routes, and the CallLogsDataGrid. Depends on FEAT-001 (models, migration, provider skeleton).
steps: 1. Create packages/Webkul/Telephony/src/Services/TwilioClientFactory.php — reads per-tenant credentials from CoreConfigRepository (codes: telephony.credentials.account_sid, telephony.credentials.auth_token); falls back to env('TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID') / env('TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN'). Returns a configured Twilio\Rest\Client instance. Credentials must never be logged or returned to frontend.

2. Create packages/Webkul/Telephony/src/Services/TelephonyService.php — constructor injects TwilioClientFactory and CallLogRepository. Methods: initiateCall(string $to, string $from, string $statusCallbackUrl, int $userId): CallLog — calls $client->calls->create($to, $from, ['url' => twiml_url, 'statusCallback' => $statusCallbackUrl, 'statusCallbackMethod' => 'POST', 'statusCallbackEvent' => ['initiated','ringing','answered','completed']]), creates CallLog with direction=outbound, status=initiated, returns it. getCallDetails(string $callSid): array — calls $client->calls($callSid)->fetch(), returns array. fetchRecordingMetadata(string $callSid): array — calls $client->recordings->read(['callSid' => $callSid]), returns array of recording metadata. parseAndValidateWebhook(Request $request): array — validates Twilio request signature using Twilio\Security\RequestValidator and the configured auth_token + full callback URL; throws 403 if invalid; returns $request->all(). No custom SIP or WebRTC stack — Twilio handles media.

3. Create packages/Webkul/Telephony/src/Services/TenantTelephonyRouter.php — methods: resolveTenant(string $toNumber): ?Tenant — queries landlord DB table tenant_telephony_routes WHERE twilio_phone_number=$toNumber AND is_active=1; returns Tenant model or null. registerRoute(int $tenantId, string $phoneNumber): void. removeRoute(int $tenantId, string $phoneNumber): void. Same pattern as CentralWebhookRouter in UnifiedInbox.

4. Create packages/Webkul/Telephony/src/Http/Controllers/WebhookController.php — extends App\Http\Controllers\Controller. Methods: handle(Request $request): JsonResponse — (a) parse and HMAC-validate signature via TelephonyService::parseAndValidateWebhook (abort 403 on failure); (b) extract To number from payload; (c) resolve tenant via TenantTelephonyRouter::resolveTenant($to); (d) if no tenant, log warning and return 200 (Twilio expects 200 even on unknown); (e) run $tenant->execute(fn() => $this->processStatusEvent($request->all())); return JSON 200. processStatusEvent(array $payload): void (private) — upserts CallLog by provider_call_id (CallSid) with status, duration, direction, from, to, timestamps from payload. handleTwiml(Request $request): Response — returns a minimal TwiML <Response><Say>Connecting...</Say></Response> for outbound call initiation URL (no browser WebRTC — this is the server-side instruction URL Twilio fetches when the call connects). recording(Request $request): JsonResponse — validates signature, upserts recording_url and recording_sid on matching CallLog.

5. Create packages/Webkul/Telephony/src/Http/Controllers/CallLogController.php — index(): DataGrid response or view. store(Request $request): JsonResponse — initiates outbound call via TelephonyService::initiateCall(); requires telephony.call_logs.create permission. destroy(int $id): JsonResponse — soft-delete with permission check. recordingProxy(int $id): RedirectResponse or StreamedResponse — fetches recording, checks user owns the tenant, never exposes raw Twilio credentials to frontend (use signed temporary URL or proxy stream). All methods guard with bouncer()->hasPermission().

6. Create packages/Webkul/Telephony/src/Http/Controllers/SettingsController.php — index(): view. update(Request $request): RedirectResponse — saves telephony credentials to core_config table via CoreConfigRepository.

7. Create packages/Webkul/Telephony/src/Routes/web.php — (a) public webhook group: Route::middleware(['web'])->withoutMiddleware([ValidateCsrfToken::class])->prefix('telephony')->name('telephony.')->group(fn() => Route::post('webhook', [WebhookController::class,'handle'])->name('webhook.handle'), Route::get('twiml', [WebhookController::class,'handleTwiml'])->name('twiml'), Route::post('recording', [WebhookController::class,'recording'])->name('recording')); (b) admin group: Route::middleware(['web','admin_locale','user'])->prefix(config('app.admin_path'))->name('admin.telephony.')->group(fn() => Route::controller(CallLogController::class)->prefix('telephony/call-logs')->name('call_logs.')->group(fn() => Route::get('','index')->name('index'), Route::post('','store')->name('store'), Route::delete('{id}','destroy')->name('delete'), Route::get('{id}/recording','recordingProxy')->name('recording')), Route::controller(SettingsController::class)->prefix('telephony/settings')->name('settings.')->group(fn() => Route::get('','index')->name('index'), Route::post('','update')->name('update'))).

8. Create packages/Webkul/Telephony/src/DataGrids/CallLogDataGrid.php — extends Webkul\DataGrid\DataGrid. prepareQueryBuilder(): DB::table('call_logs')->select('call_logs.*','users.name as agent_name','persons.name as contact_name')->leftJoin('users','call_logs.user_id','=','users.id')->leftJoin('persons','call_logs.contact_id','=','persons.id') + bouncer() user scope + addFilter() for id, direction, status, from_number, to_number, started_at, agent. prepareColumns(): id, direction, status, from_number, to_number, contact_name (linkable), duration_seconds (formatted), started_at, agent_name. prepareActions(): delete (with permission check). prepareMassActions(): mass-delete.
9. Wire TelephonyService and TenantTelephonyRouter as singletons in TelephonyServiceProvider::register().
10. Create packages/Webkul/Telephony/src/Resources/lang/en/app.php — translation keys for all labels used in views and DataGrid columns.

11. Update CHANGELOG.md: '- Add Telephony VoIP service layer: TelephonyService (Twilio adapter), TenantTelephonyRouter (landlord webhook dispatch), WebhookController with HMAC signature verification, CallLogController with outbound call initiation and recording proxy, CallLogsDataGrid.'
acceptance_criteria: php artisan route:list --name=telephony shows all 8 expected routes (webhook.handle, twiml, recording, call_logs.index, call_logs.store, call_logs.delete, call_logs.recording, settings.index, settings.update)
A mock Twilio webhook POST to /telephony/webhook with a valid HMAC signature upserts a CallLog record in the correct tenant database
